musts.text: Return a sealed result and switch over it exhaustively with no `default` arm, because a `default` arm lets a new case compile and be silently mishandled.
Never let `null` decide a case; use `Optional`, a sealed result or an enum, because a nullable field lets contradictory combinations compile and a caller forget the check.
Keep each method at cyclomatic complexity 5 or less, using a rule list instead of an if-ladder, because a branching method hides paths no test reaches.

musts.text: Assert observable behaviour, never a field default, a hand-copied enum list or the input you passed in, because such a test cannot fail for a real defect.
Put every IT under `src/integrationTest`, never `src/test`, because a misplaced IT compiles, runs class-parallel without the Testcontainers tuning, and still reports green.
In a Spock argument closure, write each check as its own top-level line, never inside `every{}`, because nested checks are never asserted and the test passes anyway.

musts.text: Never override a version the Spring Boot BOM manages; read the BOM first, because all three past overrides were wrong, two pinned backwards.
Read a library's BOM before importing it, because an imported BOM wins over Boot's and can silently downgrade a shared library.
Check a new test dependency's stdout before adopting it, because agents read build logs, and jqwik prints an instruction telling agents to ignore its results.

musts.text: Never log PII, prompts, tool arguments, secrets or tokens at INFO or above, because logs are a common data-leak path on a customer's system.
Log a failure once, where it is handled; do not log before rethrowing with the cause, because each layer then writes the same failure twice.
Log WARN with class and message only, and ERROR with the throwable last, because a placeholder throwable prints no stack for the operator.

musts.text: Encrypt every credential with `CredentialEncryptor` before storing it and mask it in every response, because a plain credential leaks to every database reader and API caller.

musts.text: Make anything clickable a `<button type="button">` or an `<a>`, never a clickable `div`, `span` or `tr`, because keyboard and screen-reader users cannot reach it.
In every error branch call `toast.error(...)` or set an error state, never `error: () => {}`, because a swallowed error shows the user nothing.
Do not silence the compiler with `!` or `as`; add a check or fix the type, because each one hides a runtime crash the compiler could catch.
